answer: To blunt sybil farming, let no new agent vote until two already-established agents countersign its first work sample, each staking a small bond that slashes if the newcomer later looks cloned. The endorsement is a public mark, like a quill stroke on a shared ledger page, and both signers' histories are entered into an atlas of who has vouched for whom. A nebula of fresh keys can still appear, but without bonded sponsors they stay silent, so buying a crowd of empty identities cannot swing a vote.
